subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's worth analyzing in these incident tickets.

judge.implied_focus: The nature/characterization of the incident (what failed, how it manifested, its scope, and whether it resolved itself) -- i.e., an incident-anatomy profile aimed at understanding drivers of incident volume and severity.

per_column.name: affected_component
per_column.rationale: Identifies the IT component involved, a core facet of characterizing what an incident is about.

per_column.name: symptom_type
per_column.rationale: Captures how the incident manifested, a coherent facet of incident anatomy.

per_column.name: scope_indicator
per_column.rationale: Describes breadth of impact (individual vs infrastructure-wide), a meaningful severity/scope facet.

per_column.name: self_resolved
per_column.rationale: Resolution behavior facet; relevant to distinguishing noise from actionable incidents.

per_column.name: recurrence_signal
per_column.rationale: Whether the incident is recurring, a strong analytical hook for root-cause work.

per_column.name: remote_access_context
per_column.rationale: Contextual attribute (remote-related) tying into connectivity/VPN patterns visible in the data.

judge.rationale: The added columns cohere around a single inferable focus: characterizing the anatomy of an incident to surface what is worth analyzing. They form differentiated facets -- what component failed (affected_component), how it presented (symptom_type), how widely it hit (scope_indicator), whether it self-resolved (self_resolved), whether it recurs (recurrence_signal), and remote-access context. These are non-trivial, data-inferable from short_description/category, and give an analyst concrete levers (recurring email/VPN/DB failures, infrastructure-wide connectivity outages) to investigate. Structure is sound at a useful granularity rather than a single restatement or generic text metrics. Minor deductions: remote_access_context overlaps with connectivity symptoms and affected_component, and recurrence_signal is heavily skewed (472/28), which weakens its discriminating value and hints at somewhat loose definition; but the set is clearly a coherent focus rather than a grab-bag.
